note: Registry of watches and river basins. Member watches (Bangladesh, Mekong) are independent archives with their own collector, policy and site; Global Sand Watch reads their published archive.json and never edits their records. Hosted regions (Kenya, Rwanda, and later others) are collected, reviewed and published by Global Sand Watch itself from watches/<id>/archive.json.

watches.name: Bangladesh Sand Watch
watches.collection: Daily GitHub Actions collector with source-body reading and second-pass model editorial review (since 11 Nov 2026); earlier scheduled-chat and manual batches.

watches.name: Mekong Sand Watch
watches.collection: Daily GitHub Actions collector in five languages plus reviewed manual import batches. Many imported summaries and translations still await owner and native-language review.

watches.name: Kenya
watches.collection: Hosted by Global Sand Watch. Seed collection of 19 November 2026 (sources read by AI research agents; dates and figures re-checked against each page), then a daily collector in this repository once its API keys are set. All records await owner review.

watches.name: Rwanda
watches.collection: Hosted by Global Sand Watch. Seed collection of 19 November 2026 (sources read by AI research agents; dates and figures re-checked against each page), then a daily collector in this repository once its API keys are set. All records await owner review.

basins.name: Ganges–Brahmaputra–Meghna
basins.note: Coverage is currently Bangladesh only, the lowest riparian. India, Nepal, Bhutan and the Tibetan upper Brahmaputra have no member watch yet.

basins.name: South-eastern Bangladesh hill and coastal rivers
basins.note: Karnaphuli, Halda, Sangu, Matamuhuri, Bakkhali and Naf drain the Chittagong hills directly to the Bay of Bengal, outside the GBM system. Records are assigned here from their named river; the assignment is a heuristic.

basins.name: Mekong
basins.note: All six riparian countries are in scope; the collection is weighted toward Viet Nam and the delta.

basins.name: Athi–Galana–Sabaki
basins.note: Kenya Water Resources Authority basin area. Includes the Makueni, Machakos, Kitui-border and Kajiado seasonal sand rivers (e.g. Thwake, Kaiti) where sand harvesting is widely reported.

basins.name: Tana
basins.note: Kenya Water Resources Authority basin area, including Kitui County's seasonal sand rivers draining to the Tana.

basins.name: Lake Victoria North and South (Kenya)
basins.note: Two Kenya Water Resources Authority basin areas draining to Lake Victoria and the Nile (Nzoia, Yala, Nyando, Sondu-Miriu, Kuja-Migori).

basins.name: Rift Valley (Kenya)
basins.note: Kenya Water Resources Authority basin area of mostly closed lake basins (Turkana, Baringo, Naivasha, Magadi).

basins.name: Ewaso Ng'iro North
basins.note: Kenya Water Resources Authority basin area covering the northern drylands.

basins.name: Kenya (national scope)
basins.note: Kenya-wide records, such as national regulations, guidelines and studies, that do not belong to a single basin area.

basins.name: Nile headwaters (Rwanda)
basins.note: Roughly two-thirds of Rwanda drains to the Nile via the Nyabarongo, Akanyaru, Mukungwa, Muvumba and Akagera.

basins.name: Congo headwaters (Rwanda)
basins.note: Western Rwanda drains to Lake Kivu and the Rusizi, part of the Congo basin (e.g. the Sebeya).

basins.name: Rwanda (national scope)
basins.note: Rwanda-wide records, such as national policy, licensing and studies, that do not belong to a single basin.
